data.name: About_Intro
data.value: Wunschkino is a web portal for family and friends of a Jellyfin installation: you see which movies and series are already there and can wish for new ones.

data.name: About_License
data.value: Wunschkino is free software under the {0}. Anyone who runs a modified version as a service must offer its users the source code.

data.name: About_Sources
data.value: Movies, series, posters and descriptions come from {0}. The anime search uses the public API of {1}; the mapping of anime numbers is provided by the community list {2}.

data.name: About_Fonts
data.value: The interface uses the Geist typeface (SIL Open Font License 1.1), shipped with the application, and MudBlazor (MIT). All third-party components and their licenses are listed in the file THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md in the {0}.

data.name: About_A11y
data.value: This interface aims to conform to WCAG 2.1, level AA: keyboard operation, contrast, labelled fields and controls, a link to skip the navigation and respect for “reduce motion”. The pages are checked automatically with axe-core; a full manual check with screen readers is still pending. Please report barriers to the operators of this installation.

data.name: Privacy_Intro
data.value: This information describes what the Wunschkino software processes. The operator of this installation is responsible for it and can provide their own information.

data.name: Privacy_Data1
data.value: Account: username, password (stored only as a hash), role and creation date.

data.name: Privacy_Data2
data.value: Wishes: wished-for title, optional note, time, votes and status; depending on the operator's setting, other users do not see who a wish comes from.

data.name: Privacy_Data3
data.value: Audit log for admins: sign-ins and administrative actions for 365 days, the IP addresses involved and those of blocked addresses for 90 days.

data.name: Privacy_Data4
data.value: Protection against abuse: the IP address is counted on failed sign-in attempts in order to block it temporarily.

data.name: Privacy_Data5
data.value: System log of the server and of an upstream proxy: time, IP address, requested address and, for failed sign-ins, the username entered. The operator sets up how long these are kept.

data.name: Privacy_Purpose
data.value: The data is used to provide the portal (Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR) and to operate it securely (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR).

data.name: Privacy_Recipients
data.value: The server sends search terms and IMDb numbers to TMDB, and for the anime search to AniList. The browser never contacts a third party: typeface, images and scripts come from this server, and there is no advertising, no web analytics and no embedded content. The library comes from the operator's Jellyfin server.

data.name: Privacy_Cookie1
data.value: Wunschkino.Auth: keeps you signed in. Strictly necessary, valid until the browser closes, up to 14 days with “Stay signed in”.

data.name: Privacy_Cookie2
data.value: Antiforgery cookie (name starts with .AspNetCore.Antiforgery): protects forms against forged requests. Strictly necessary, valid until the browser closes.

data.name: Privacy_CookiesNote
data.value: No other cookies or browser storage (localStorage, sessionStorage) are used; consent is therefore not required (Section 25(2) no. 2 TDDDG). The chosen appearance (light or dark) is stored with the account in the database, not in the browser.

data.name: Privacy_Storage
data.value: Accounts, wishes and votes are kept until an admin deletes them. Audit log entries are removed automatically after the periods stated above.

data.name: Privacy_Rights
data.value: You can request access to your data as well as rectification, erasure, restriction of processing and object to processing, and you can lodge a complaint with a data protection supervisory authority. To do so, contact the controller named above.

data.name: Settings_LegalHint
data.value: Optional. Texts appear under /impressum and /datenschutz and can be reached without signing in. Plain text only, no HTML; blank lines separate paragraphs. Whether you need a legal notice is your decision as operator; this is not legal advice.
